dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, your room is so tidy! Mine is always messy.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, jʊr ˈruːm ɪz ˈsoʊ ˈtaɪdi! ˈmaɪn ɪz ˈɔːlweɪz ˈmɛsi.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: When I was a child, my parents made me clean my room every weekend.
dialogue.reading: wɛn aɪ wʌz ə ˈtʃaɪld, maɪ ˈpɛrənts ˈmeɪd miː ˈkliːn maɪ ˈruːm ˈɛvri ˈwiːkɛnd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, very strict. They didn't let me watch TV on weekdays.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ˈvɛri ˈstrɪkt. ðeɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈlɛt miː ˈwɑːtʃ ˌtiːˈviː ɑːn ˈwiːkdeɪz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Wow. Did they punish you when your room was messy?
dialogue.reading: ˈwaʊ. dɪd ðeɪ ˈpʌnɪʃ juː wɛn jʊr ˈruːm wʌz ˈmɛsi?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sometimes. They didn't give me my allowance!
dialogue.reading: ˈsʌmtaɪmz. ðeɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈɡɪv miː maɪ əˈlaʊəns!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: My parents gave me an allowance, too. But they made me do the dishes for it.
dialogue.reading: maɪ ˈpɛrənts ˈɡeɪv miː ən əˈlaʊəns, ˈtuː. bʌt ðeɪ ˈmeɪd miː ˈduː ðə ˈdɪʃɪz fər ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Did they let you stay up late?
dialogue.reading: dɪd ðeɪ ˈlɛt juː ˈsteɪ ˈʌp ˈleɪt?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Only on Saturdays. They let us watch movies until eleven.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊnli ɑːn ˈsætərdeɪz. ðeɪ ˈlɛt ʌs ˈwɑːtʃ ˈmuːviz ənˈtɪl ɪˈlɛvən.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's nice! My parents never let me stay up late.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈnaɪs! maɪ ˈpɛrənts ˈnɛvər ˈlɛt miː ˈsteɪ ˈʌp ˈleɪt.
